name: Warsong Axe Shipment
summary: At Booty Bay, the Warsong Axe Shipment waits for its voyage to Ashenvale. The newly forged axes are bound for the Warsong Outriders and the work at their lumber camp.

sections.title: A Long Voyage Across the Seas
sections.body: Axes for the Warsong Lumber Camp wait in Booty Bay. The camp’s woodcutters need a steady supply of durable tools, and not every tool can be forged on the front lines. Orders cross the Great Sea to this neutral goblin port, where the crate is stored near Wharfmaster Lozgil. The sharpened axes are meant for Splintertree Post, where they can be sent onward to the camp. Keeping distant frontier camps supplied takes a long journey across the sea.

faq.q: Where is the Warsong Axe Shipment located?
faq.answer: The crate sits on the docks of Booty Bay, at the southern tip of Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why is a shipment for Ashenvale all the way down in Booty Bay?
faq.answer: The Blackwater Raiders and the Steamwheedle Cartel carry merchant cargo across the Great Sea. Booty Bay connects distant lands, so the Horde’s tools pass through its port.
Locke Okarr, an outrider at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale, needs the axes to replenish the Warsong Lumber Camp’s dwindling stocks.

faq.q: Who oversees the delivery in Booty Bay?
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Lozgil oversees maritime cargo at Booty Bay, where the shipment waits for transport to Kalimdor.

angles.text: For the Horde, this crate helps keep the Warsong Lumber Camp supplied and productive under constant pressure from hostile forces in Ashenvale.
For the Warsong clan, sharp axes mean more timber for the growing foundations of Orgrimmar and Durotar.
